description: Paper-constrained simulation with explicit assumptions for unpublished sampling ranges.

paper_fixed: Wulff, Winterbottom, and randomly plane-cut particle families
oversampling ratio greater than two in every spatial direction
two-Gaussian, two-cosine, and 3D Gaussian-correlated phase families
real-space phase peak-to-peak variation between 2pi and 5pi
replication_assumptions: The article does not publish the complete random-parameter distributions.
Ranges in shape, phase, and noise sections are configurable engineering assumptions.
Poisson noise is parameterized by expected photons at the brightest detector voxel.
FFT-based kinematic scattering is used because the public repository does not include the authors' PyNX generator.
